one_time_tokens_transfer_fields_check.name: one_time_tokens_transfer_fields_check
one_time_tokens_transfer_fields_check.value: "one_time_tokens"."purpose" <> 'ownership_transfer' or ("one_time_tokens"."org_id" is not null and "one_time_tokens"."created_by" is not null)

projects_time_fields_distinct_check.name: projects_time_fields_distinct_check
projects_time_fields_distinct_check.value: "projects"."estimation_field_id" is null or "projects"."spent_time_field_id" is null or "projects"."estimation_field_id" <> "projects"."spent_time_field_id"

issues_start_date_check.name: issues_start_date_check
issues_start_date_check.value: "issues"."start_date" is null or "issues"."due_date" is null or "issues"."start_date" <= "issues"."due_date"

attachments_parent_shape_check.name: attachments_parent_shape_check
attachments_parent_shape_check.value:
not ("attachments"."issue_id" is not null and "attachments"."article_id" is not null)
        and ("attachments"."work_item_id" is null or "attachments"."issue_id" is not null)
        and ("attachments"."comment_id" is null or "attachments"."issue_id" is not null or "attachments"."article_id" is not null)

sprints_start_date_check.name: sprints_start_date_check
sprints_start_date_check.value: "sprints"."start_date" is null or "sprints"."end_date" is null or "sprints"."start_date" <= "sprints"."end_date"

board_columns_wip_order_check.name: board_columns_wip_order_check
board_columns_wip_order_check.value: "board_columns"."wip_min" is null or "board_columns"."wip_max" is null or "board_columns"."wip_min" <= "board_columns"."wip_max"
